The PKGBUILD defines sources using the package's own GitHub repository release URLs, which are standard and expected for binary packages. The `source` array entries for x86_64 and aarch64 architectures point to prebuilt tarballs hosted on GitHub, and their corresponding `sha256sums` are provided, ensuring integrity verification. The variables are safely expanded and do not trigger external downloads or side effects when the PKGBUILD is sourced. The `case` block at the bottom sets an architecture variable based on `CARCH`, which is a common and safe pattern in multi-arch PKGBUILDs. No functions or code outside of `package()` are defined or executed during sourcing, and `--nobuild --noprepare --printsrcinfo` will not invoke the `package()` function. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD and downloading the sources poses no risk of executing malicious code.
</details>
